prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: are you flying in & out of San Juan Puerto Rico? MSP is my airport. I am working on flying a dog to my home in Minnesota.
Delta: Thank you for asking. We have flights from MSP to San Juan via Atlanta or JFK. Please check our website at https://t.co/gPInVR2LJ6 for schedules or call 800-221-1212 for assistance. If you make your reservation online please call or tweet us for adding the dog. *TDL

Customer: Delta, Im trying to make a Puerto Rico flight change and the hold time is 2+hours.  Please advise another solution.
Delta: Thanks for reaching out to us. Please DM us your confirmation number and we'll gladly look into it for you. *AMC

Customer: Thank you  from 8D for getting me home safely once again... https://t.co/EIFq66lCsB
Delta: Awesome picture! Thanks for sharing and for choosing Delta!  *TMB

Customer: Hey,  💙 https://t.co/p9VJVJyFKI
Delta: Great picture! Thank you for sharing. *TDH

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: general_question):
"""Hey  when is the cargo ban getting lifted? My cousin would like to come home from Puerto Rico with her doggie 🐶 #help"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Thanks for reaching out! For the latest on cargo restrictions and pet travel, please DM us your reservation details or call 800‑221‑1212 and we’ll help you with your cousin’s doggie.
